answer: Sybil resistance uses a staked identity ridge: every new alias must post collateral stacked above the previous one, so cloning a thousand agents forces an attacker to lock a steep, expensive ridge of capital. Honest agents emit a signed work signal that others verify cheaply; fakes have none. Double-voting slashes the entire ridge, so the cheater forfeits every pearl of stake, far beyond any single forged vote's gain.
